steps.u: The seat map crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading row)' when an event has a standing-only section. Repro: event 77.

steps.r:
src/seatmap/layout.ts:33: const r = seat.row * ROW_HEIGHT
src/seatmap/layout.ts:58: sections.map(s => s.seats[0].row)

steps.a: Standing sections have an empty seats array, so seats[0] is undefined and .row throws. I'll skip sections with no numbered seats when computing the top.

Event 77 now renders; standing sections are left out of the row calculation. Math.min of an all-standing event would still return Infinity, which the renderer treats as no seats, so I left that alone.

reference.summary: Fixed the seat map crash on events with standing-only sections: those sections have no seats, so reading the first seat's row threw. Empty sections are now skipped when computing the top row, with a unit test; the event 77 repro passes.
facts: seats array is empty so seats[0] is undefined
sections without seats are now filtered out
an all-standing event would give Infinity which the renderer tolerates
